bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; requiring a report; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; CONTINUOUS LIVING COVER CROPS. +]

[+$5,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development to make grants, in consultation with the commissioner of agriculture, to organizations in Minnesota to develop enterprises, supply chains, and markets for continuous living cover crops and cropping systems in the early stage of commercial development, including regenerative poultry silvopasture systems, Kernza perennial grain, winter camelina, and elderberry. A grantee may not receive a grant for the same purposes as this section from another agency within the same calendar year. By January 15th, 2027, the commissioner must report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over economic development and agriculture regarding the uses of grant funds, including the amount of grant funds used for administration. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; requiring a report; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CONTINUOUS LIVING COVER CROPS.

$5,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development to make grants, in consultation with the commissioner of agriculture, to organizations in Minnesota to develop enterprises, supply chains, and markets for continuous living cover crops and cropping systems in the early stage of commercial development, including regenerative poultry silvopasture systems, Kernza perennial grain, winter camelina, and elderberry. A grantee may not receive a grant for the same purposes as this section from another agency within the same calendar year. By January 15th, 2027, the commissioner must report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over economic development and agriculture regarding the uses of grant funds, including the amount of grant funds used for administration. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: $5,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development to make grants, in consultation with the commissioner of agriculture, to organizations in Minnesota to develop enterprises, supply chains, and markets for continuous living cover crops and cropping systems in the early stage of commercial development, including regenerative poultry silvopasture systems, Kernza perennial grain, winter camelina, and elderberry. A grantee may not receive a grant for the same purposes as this section from another agency within the same calendar year. By January 15th, 2027, the commissioner must report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over economic development and agriculture regarding the uses of grant funds, including the amount of grant funds used for administration. This is a onetime appropriation.
